scenes.text: IMAGINE SHARING ELEVEN QUARRISIZED PIECES AMONG A GROUP COUNTING PIECES IS EASY BUT HOW MANY WHOLE UNITS COULD YOU BUILD THERE'S MORE THAN ONE WAY TO NAME THIS AMOUNT
TO DAY WE'RE LEARNING TO REPRESENT AND CONVERT MIXED NUMBERS AND IMPROPER FRACTIONS WITHOUT CHANGING THE AMOUNT THEY DESCRIBE
YOU'LL GROUP EQUAL PIECES TO SEE COMPLETE HOLES AND ANY EXTRA PART
YOU'LL TURN AN IMPROPER FRACTION INTO A MIXED NUMBER AND GO BACK THE OTHER WAY
YOU'LL CHECK THAT BOTH NAMES MATCH THE SAME MODEL OR NUMBER LINED POSITION
FIRST CHOOSE ONE WHOLE ITS PARTS MUST BE EQUAL IN SIZE THE OUTLINE OF THE MODEL SHOWS THE ENTIRE WHOLE NOT JUST THE COLORED SHARE
HERE THREE EQUAL PARTS ARE CHOSEN OUT OF FOUR THE TOP NUMBER THE NUMERATOR COUNTS CHOSEN PARTS THE BOTTOM NUMBER THE DENOMINATOR TELLS HOW MANY EQUAL PARTS MAKE THE WHOLE
HOW MANY COMPLETE HOLES CAN YOU BUILD FROM ELEVEN QUARTERS GROUP FOUR PIECES AT A TIME AND NOTICE ANY PIECES LEFT OVER
FOUR QUARTERS MAKE ONE HOLE ANOTHER FOUR QUARTERS MAKE A SECOND HOLE THREE QUARTERS ARE LEFT OVER
ELEVEN QUARTERS IS AN IMPROPER FRACTION ITS NUMERATOR IS AT LEAST AS LARGE AS ITS DENOMINATOR IT CAN DESCRIBE ONE WHOLE OR MORE
TWO AND THREE QUARTERS IS A MIXED NUMBER IT COMBINES TWO WHOLE UNITS WITH A FRACTIONAL PART
TO CONVERT DIVIDE ELEVEN BY FOUR ELEVEN DIVIDED BY FOUR IS TWO WITH THE REMAINDER OF THREE
THE DENOMINATOR STAYS FOUR BECAUSE OUR PIECES ARE STILL QUARTERS SO ELEVEN QUARTERS EQUALS TWO AND THREE QUARTERS
THE REMAINDER COUNTS EXTRA QUARTER SIZED PIECES IT DOESN'T BECOME THE DENOMINATOR A PICTURE HELPS YOU SEE TWO COMPLETE HOLES AND THREE QUARTERS OF THE NEXT ONE
HOW COULD YOU COUNT ALL THE FIFTH SIZED PIECES IN THREE AND TWO FIFTHS REMEMBER THAT EACH HOLE CONTAINS FIVE FIFTHS
NOW GO THE OTHER WAY DIG THREE AND TWO FIFTHS EACH HOLE CONTAINS FIVE FIFTY
THREE TIMES FIVE GIVES FIFTEEN FIFTH ADD THE EXTRA TWO FIFTH TO MAKE SEVENTEEN FIFTH
SO THREE AND TWO FIFTH EQUAL SEVENTEEN FIFTH MULTIPLY THE WHOLE NUMBER BY THE DENOMINATOR AT THE NUMERATOR AND KEEP THE DENOMINATOR
COUNTING IN FIFTHS DOESN'T CHANGE THE WHOLE OR THE AMOUNT IT SIMPLY REPLACES THE WHOLE NUMBER GROUPS WITH A SINGLE COUNT OF EQUAL PIECES
A MIXED NUMBER ISN'T MADE BY ADDING ITS WHOLE NUMBER TO ITS NUMER TWO AND THREE QUARTERS IS NOT FIVE QUARTERS THE TWO HOLES ALREADY CONTAIN EIGHT QUARTERS
EIGHT QUARTERS PLUS THREE QUARTERS IS ELEVEN QUARTERS THAT'S WHY WE MULTIPLY THE WHOLE NUMBER BY THE DENOMINATOR THEN ADD THE EXTRA ENUMERATOR
A FRACTION CAN ALSO EQUAL AN EXACT HOLE EIGHT QUARTERS IS TWO HOLES WITH NO FRACTIONAL PART LEFT OVER
TO COMPARE MIXED NUMBERS COMPARE THE HOLES FIRST THREE AND ONE QUARTER IS GREATER THAN TWO AND THREE QUARTERS
IF THE WHOLE'S MATCH COMPARE THE FRACTIONAL PARTS TWO AND ONE HALF IS GREATER THAN TWO AND ONE QUARTER
A NUMBER LINE HELPS US CHECK AMOUNTS BEYOND ONE TWO AND ONE HALF IS TEN QUARTER STEPS FROM ZERO TWO AND THREE QUARTERS IS ONE QUARTER STEP FURTHER TO THE RIGHT
HOW MANY HOLES AND QUARTERS ARE IN NINE QUARTERS
NINE QUARTERS IS TWO HOLES AND ONE QUARTER

OUR GOAL WAS TO CONNECT MIXED NUMBERS AND IMPROPER FRACTIONS YOU CAN BUILD HOLES COUNT THE LEFT OVER PARTS AND CONVERT IN EITHER DIRECTION BEFORE CALCULATING WHAT WOULD YOUR AMOUNT LOOK LIKE TRY DRAWING IT THEN PRACTISE ON MATHEM
